Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The Vendor (Company/Firm/Bidder etc.) should be Kashmir valley based or having a branch office for offering swift progress / seamless Service. 2. The vendor is required to visit the site before participate the bid to get a ccess the actual requirement / site visit for proper rate bidding / requirement of work need to be executed at ground. 3. The L1 vendor is required to submit to get pass the samples of the ever y intermediate goods need to execute the GeM Contract including a semi- finished and a fully finished piece of 5 feet long each fence sample for approval. 4. In case non satisfactory samples / non satisfactory work this Headquart ers, however reserve the right to terminate the contract at any time. 5. The period of completion of this particular work for supply / fix / installati on of fence (as mentioned in the work and as per the drawings attached with th e bid) shall be strict in the GeM Contract and prompt / timely work is must ensu re. 6. Maintenance. The L1 vendor is to provide maintenance of the fence for t he guarantee period of 1 year. 7. The vendor quoting the rates should be registered with the Sales Tax/Se rvice Tax/GST authorities. (Copy to be enclose.) 8. If the work of the Vendor is found unsatisfactory or if the Vendor dishonours the contract, the contract will be terminated summarily by the Com petent Authority at any time and the job will be entrusted to any other Vendor a t the risk and expenses of the defaulting Vendor. In this connection, the decision of the Competent Authority shall be final and binding on the Vendor. 9. The work is to be carried out in the office premises itself. However, only such work as cannot be done in the office premises will be allowed to be done o utside with written permission of the Commander this Headquarters and no extr a payment would be made on this account. 10. No increase in amount shall be considered at all during the currency of t he Contract. No other charges like transportation fare etc. Will be payable for e xecution of work. 11. The intending vendors must have at least three years’ experience in undertaking GeM Contracts with at least work experience to carry out the GeM contracts at least three different offices / reputed Organizations / different divisi ons. 12. The Vendor should not have been blacklisted by any Ministry/Departmen t of Central/State Govt. 13. All stores / tools / machinery required to get done the contract will be pr ovided by the firm at his own cost, no departmental tools / machinery will be pr ovided. 14. The firm will provide materials/eqpt required for the Job and testing of the it em and the rates would be deemed to include the cost there INSPECTION AND T ESTING.

15. After the layout and installation of the fence is inspected jointly by the consi gnee and the firm and the report will be submitted to the Commander for furthe r necessary action. 16. The work as per the Contract carried out will be finally inspected by the Co mmander this Headquarters and the firm shall provide all the assistance design ed inspecting authority including each measurement instruments. 17. Penalty: (a) If the vendor fails to complete all services within the stipulated perio d in accordance with GeM Contract Order. The supplier/vendor may ask for exte nsion of time duly quoting valid reason for delay in stipulated time frame other wise Liquidation Damages as per the policy @ 0.5% (or as per the latest rates ci rculated by the competent authority) of the GeM contract Order cost of the dela yed completion for delay of every week or part thereof, subject to a maximum o f 10% of the value of delayed completion 18. Payment: (a) No advance payment will be made in any case. (b) Payment shall be made only after the satisfactory completion of the work. (c)The consignee will issue the completion certificate after the inspection and approval by the Commander this Headquarters. (c) The bills along with the connected documents will be subjected to pr e audit by associated AO, GE (AF) Srinagar prior to releasing payment. (d) Payment will be made through e-payment in the account of the firm. (e) No Payment in respect to any inflation will be addressed. The amount of the contract will be the final in case of satisfactory and timely completi on. (f) Penalty, if any, imposed during the period shall be deducted from the fi nal payment. (g) The Net amount will be paid after deduction of TDS as applicable. 19. Vendor will not sub-contract or permit anyone other than the company p ersonnel to perform any of the work service or other performance required unde r this Service level Agreement (SLA) without the prior written consent of the Co mmander this Headquarters. 20. The scope of work covers comprehensibly as per the documents attache d along with the bid. 21. The required drawing is also attached along the bid 22. The scope of work also includes the maintenance of paint work and the f ence for any minor / major defects if occurs in 1 year w.e.f the date of completi on of the work. 23. The vendor shall also be responsible for deployment of skilled workers f or proper works-man-ship to achieve neat / clean and a perfect fence.

24. The steel parts shall be of good quality approved by the competent auth ority free from joints in length and free from any kind of rust. 25. The fence shall be neatly fabricated with smooth welding joints in runnin g welding dully grinded the edges for smooth finish and to achieve glossy paint finish. 26. The vendor shall maintain the site neat and clean, dumping of steel part s / other material shall be stocked properly to avoid any hindrance to the Officer s / staff / visitors/ vehicles. 27. All stored / stocked material shall be covered with the Green cloth. 28. In case of any dispute between the parties, decision of Commander Hea dquarters CWE (AF) Srinagar would be final and binding. .
